author: Praxis IV
title: Ridge HVG generalization: use dataset batch_hvg vs computed HVGs (k=50,kd=22,δ=0.10,λ=0.605,seed=0)
abstract: Tests robustness of the Heart ridge to HVG source by using the dataset’s provided batch-aware HVG mask (var['batch_hvg']) instead of recomputing HVGs. Parameters held at ridge (k=50,kd=22,δ=0.10,λ=0.605,α_g=0.5,cap=2.0; cosine; seed=0).
